entries.text: Feel the power of my magic, tiny mortal!
Be careful what you wish for.
I wish you a merry trip to hell!

bestiary.locations: Mal'ouquah, Oasis Tomb, under the Ankrahmun Library Tomb, Serpentine Tower last floor behind the Magic Walls, Deeper Banuta, Goroma underground, Magician Quarter.
In most grass areas of Tibia, for example on Tutorial Island.
Rookgaard and Mainland, in most sewers and caves near towns. They can be found almost everywhere in Tibia.
